title: Akademik yozuv
goal_uz: Dars oxirida ingliz tilida akademik matn yozasiz: abstract, xulosa, iqtibos iboralari, akademik hedging, parafraz va pametlashdan qochish.

scenes.title: Akademik yozuv
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda ilmiy maqola o‘qishni o‘rgandik. Bugun ingliz tilida akademik yozuvni o‘rganamiz: abstract, xulosa, iqtibos iboralari, akademik hedging, parafraz va pametlashdan qochish. Dars oxirida 150 so‘zli abstract yozasiz. Abstract — akademik matnning eng muhim qismi — u butun tadqiqotni bir paragraphga jamlaydi.
scenes.say: Welcome to lesson eight of PRO 2! Today we learn academic writing: abstracts, paraphrasing, citing and avoiding plagiarism.
scenes.say_uz: PRO 2 ning sakkizinchi darsiga xush kelibsiz! Bugun akademik yozuvni o‘rganamiz: abstract, parafraz, iqtibos va pametlashdan qochish.

scenes.title: Abstract tuzilishi: background, aim, method, result, conclusion

examples.t: This study examines the effect of sleep on memory.
examples.uz: Ushbu tadqiqot uxlashning xotir ko‘rsatkichiga ta‘sirini o‘rganadi.

examples.t: The results indicate that sleep improves recall.

scenes.say_native: Akademik abstractning beshta qismi. Birinchisi — „Background“ — muhit — „This study examines the effect of sleep on memory“ — mavzu haqida umumiy gap. Ikkinchisi — „Aim“ — maqsad — „The aim of this study is to…“. Uchinchisi — „Method“ — usul — „We conducted a survey of 200 students“ — biz 200 talaba bilan so‘rov o‘tkazdik. To‘rtinchisi — „Result“ — natija — „The results indicate that sleep improves recall“ — natijalar. Beshinchisi — „Conclusion“ — xulosa — „In conclusion, adequate sleep is essential for learning“ — sifatli uxlash o‘rganish uchun muhim. Eslab qoling: background — aim — method — result — conclusion — abstractning beshta ustuni — 150-250 so‘z — har biri bir jumlada aylanadi.
scenes.say: This study examines the effect of sleep on memory. The aim of this study is to investigate how adequate sleep improves learning outcomes. We conducted a survey of 200 students. The results indicate that adequate sleep significantly improves recall. In conclusion, adequate sleep is essential for learning.
scenes.say_uz: Ushbu tadqiqot uxlashning xotir ko‘rsatkichiga ta’sirini o‘rganadi. Ushbu tadqiqotning maqsadi sifatli uxlash o‘rganish natijalarini qanday yaxshilashini aniqlash. Biz 200 talabani so‘rov qildik. Natijalar sifatli uxlash xotirani sezilarli yaxshilashini ko‘rsatdi. Xulosa qilib aytganda, sifatli uxlash o‘rganish uchun muhim.

scenes.title: Abstract mashqi
scenes.say_native: Uchta abstract qismi gapi tuzing. Birinchi: „This study examines…“ — background. Ikkinchi: „The aim of this study is to…“ — aim. Uchinchi: „The results indicate that…“ — result. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida ayting. Parafraz — ma‘noni o‘z so‘zlaringiz bilan — plagiatning yo‘q qilish kaliti.
scenes.say: This study examines the effect of sleep on memory. The aim of this study is to investigate sleep and learning. The results indicate that adequate sleep improves recall. In conclusion, adequate sleep is essential.
scenes.say_uz: Ushbu tadqiqot uxlashning xotir ko‘rsatkichiga ta’sirini o‘rganadi. Ushbu tadqiqotning maqsadi uxlash va o‘rganishni aniqlash. Natijalar sifatli uxlash xotirani yaxshilashini ko‘rsatdi. Xulosa qilib aytganda, sifatli uxlash muhim.

scenes.title: Parafraz va xulosa qilish: paraphrase and summary

examples.t: Original: Sleep improves memory. Paraphrase: Rest enhances recall.
examples.uz: Original: uxlash xotirani yaxshilaydi. Parafraz: dam olish xotirani kuchaytiradi.

examples.t: Original: The study was conducted. Paraphrase: The research was carried out.
examples.uz: Original: tadqiqot o‘tkazildi. Parafraz: tadqiqot olib borildi.

scenes.say_native: Parafraz qilishning uchta texnikasi. Birinchisi — sinonimlar — „Synnymlar: sleep improves memory → Rest enhances recall“ — uxlash xotirani yaxshilaydi → dam olish xotirani kuchaytiradi. Ikkinchisi — gap tuzilishini o‘zgartirish — „The study was conducted → The research was carried out“ — tadqiqot o‘tkazildi → tadqiqot olib borildi — aktivni passivga aylantiring. Uchinchisi — so‘z turkimini o‘zgartirish — „sleep (noun) → to sleep (verb)“ — „She needs to sleep“ — u uxlashi kerak. Eslab qoling: parafraz — sinonimlar + gap tuzilishi + so‘z turkimi — uchala — plagiatdan qochishning kaliti. Iqtiboslar — har bir manbani — muallif va yil bilan — aniq ko‘rsating. Parafraz qiling — har bir jumlani o‘z so‘zlaringiz bilan — siz hech qachon nusxa qilmaysiz.
scenes.say: Paraphrase using synonyms: sleep improves memory becomes rest enhances recall. Paraphrase by changing the sentence structure: the study was conducted becomes the research was carried out. Paraphrase by changing word class: sleep as a noun becomes to sleep as a verb.
scenes.say_uz: Sinonimlar bilan parafraz qiling: uxlash xotirani yaxshilaydi — dam olish xotirani kuchaytiradi. Gap tuzilishini o‘zgartiring: tadqiqot o‘tkazildi — tadqiqot olib borildi. So‘z turkimini o‘zgartiring: sleep ot sifatida — to sleep fe’l sifatida.

scenes.title: Parafraz mashqi
scenes.say_native: Uchta parafraz qiling: „Sleep improves memory“ → „Rest enhances recall“ — sinonimlar; „The study was conducted“ → „The research was carried out“ — tuzilish; „sleep (verb)“ → „sleep (noun)“ — so‘z turkimi. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida ayting. Akademik yumshoqlik — da‘voni hech qachon haddan oshirmang — suggest va appears to ishlating.
scenes.say: Paraphrase: sleep improves memory — rest enhances recall. Paraphrase: the study was conducted — the research was carried out. Paraphrase: to sleep as a noun becomes sleep.
scenes.say_uz: Parafraz qiling: uxlash xotirani yaxshilaydi — dam olish xotirani kuchaytiradi. Parafraz qiling: tadqiqot o‘tkazildi — tadqiqot olib borildi. Parafraz qiling: to sleep fe’lidan otga aylantiring.

scenes.title: Iqtibos iboralari: citation phrases

examples.t: According to Smith (2020), adequate sleep improves recall.
examples.uz: Smith (2020) bo‘yicha, sifatli uxlash xotirani yaxshilaydi.

examples.t: Research suggests that sleep is essential for learning.
examples.uz: Tadqiqotlar uxlash o‘rganish uchun muhimligini ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.say_native: Akademik iqtibos iboralarining uchta asosiy qoidasi. Birinchisi — „According to Smith (2020)…“ — Smith (2020) bo‘yicha… — muallif va yil — „According to Smith (2020), adequate sleep improves recall“. Ikkinchisi — „Smith (2020) argues that…“ — Smith (2020) ta‘kidlaydiki… — „arguing“ — ta‘kidlash — fikr-muallif birikmasi. Uchinchisi — „Research suggests that…“ — tadqiqotlar ko‘rsatadiki… — shaxssiz — „Evidence indicates…“ — dalillar ko‘rsatadiki. Eslab qoling: according to — argues — suggests — iqtibosning uchta asosiy shakli. Pametlashdan qochish — har bir manbani iqtibos keltiring — ko‘chirmang. Iqtibos iqtibos emas — manbani ham yodingizda tuting — iqtibos iqtibos qoladi.
scenes.say: According to Smith (2020), adequate sleep improves recall. Smith (2020) argues that adequate sleep significantly improves memory. Research suggests that adequate sleep is essential for learning. Evidence indicates that adequate sleep improves cognitive performance.
scenes.say_uz: Smith (2020) bo‘yicha, sifatli uxlash xotirani yaxshilaydi. Smith (2020) sifatli uxlash xotirani sezilarli yaxshilashini ta’kidlaydi. Tadqiqotlar sifatli uxlash o‘rganish uchun muhimligini ko‘rsatadi. Dalillar sifatli uxlash kognitiv ko‘rsatkichni yaxshilashini ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.title: Iqtibos mashqi
scenes.say_native: Uchta iqtibos gapi tuzing: „According to Smith (2020)…“; „Smith (2020) argues that…“; „Research suggests that…“. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida ayting. Savollaringizni matnga qaray turib tayyorlang — ular aniq va qisqa bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: According to Smith (2020), adequate sleep improves recall. Smith (2020) argues that adequate sleep improves memory. Research suggests that adequate sleep is essential.
scenes.say_uz: Smith (2020) bo‘yicha, sifatli uxlash xotirani yaxshilaydi. Smith (2020) sifatli uxlash xotirani yaxshilashini ta’kidlaydi. Tadqiqotlar sifatli uxlash muhimligini ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.title: Akademik hedging: suggesting, indicating, appearing

examples.t: The results suggest that adequate sleep improves recall.
examples.uz: Natijalar sifatli uxlash xotirani yaxshilashini taxmin qiladi.

examples.t: The findings appear to support this hypothesis.

scenes.say_native: Akademik tonda hech qachon qat‘iy da‘vo qilinmaydi — muallif natijalarni yumshoq til bilan ifodalaydi. „suggests“ — taxmin qiladi — „The results suggest that adequate sleep improves recall“ — natijalar sifatli uxlash xotirani yaxshilashini taxmin qiladi — yumshoq. „indicates“ — ko‘rsatadi — „The data indicate that adequate sleep improves recall“ — ma‘lumotlar ko‘rsatadi. „appears to“ — ko‘rinadi — „The findings appear to support this hypothesis“ — topilmalar ushbu gipotezani qo‘llab-quvvatlayotganga o‘xshaydi. „may / might“ — mumkin — „These results may indicate a link“ — bu natijalar bog‘liqlikni ko‘rsatishi mumkin. Eslab qoling: suggests — indicates — appears to — may — akademik yumshoqlik. Javoblaringizni takrorlang — akademik suhbatda aniqlik — tushunishni mustahkamlaydi.
scenes.say: The results suggest that adequate sleep improves recall. The data indicate that adequate sleep improves recall. The findings appear to support this hypothesis. These results may indicate a link between sleep and learning.
scenes.say_uz: Natijalar sifatli uxlash xotirani yaxshilashini taxmin qiladi. Ma’lumotlar sifatli uxlash xotirani yaxshilashini ko‘rsatadi. Topilmalar ushbu gipotezani qo‘llab-quvvatlayotganga o‘xshaydi. Bu natijalar uxlash va o‘rganish o‘rtasidagi bog‘liqlikni ko‘rsatishi mumkin.

scenes.title: Hedging mashqi
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta yumshoq gap tuzing: „The results suggest that…“; „The data indicate that…“; „The findings appear to support…“; „These results may indicate…“. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida ayting. Savollaringizni ingliz tilida tayyorlang — akademik munozarada ishonch — eng kuchli qurol.
scenes.say: The results suggest that adequate sleep improves recall. The data indicate that adequate sleep improves memory. The findings appear to support this hypothesis. These results may indicate a link.
scenes.say_uz: Natijalar sifatli uxlash xotirani yaxshilashini taxmin qiladi. Ma’lumotlar sifatli uxlash xotirani yaxshilashini ko‘rsatadi. Topilmalar ushbu gipotezani qo‘llab-quvvatlayotganga o‘xshaydi. Bu natijalar bog‘liqlikni ko‘rsatishi mumkin.

scenes.title: Pametlashdan qochish: avoiding plagiarism

examples.t: Smith (2020) found that adequate sleep improves recall.
examples.uz: Smith (2020) sifatli uxlash xotirani yaxshilashini aniqladi.

scenes.say_native: Pametlashdan qochishning uchta qoidasi. Birinchisi — har bir manbani iqtibos keltiring — „Smith (2020) found that adequate sleep improves recall“ — Smith (2020) sifatli uxlash xotirani yaxshilashini aniqladi — manba qisqacha. Ikkinchisi — parafraz qiling, ko‘chirmang — „copy-pasting is plagiarism“ — nusxalash — plagiat — ma‘noni o‘z so‘zlaringiz bilan yozing. Uchinchisi — to‘g‘ri iqtibos uchun qo‘shtirnoq va manba yozing — „Sleep is essential“ (Smith, 2020) — qo‘shtirnoq va manba — to‘g‘ri iqtibos. Eslab qoling: cite — paraphrase — quote — pametlashdan qochishning uch ustuni. Javoblaringizni takrorlang — akademik suhbatda ishonch — tushunishni mustahkamlaydi.
scenes.say: Smith (2020) found that adequate sleep improves recall. Paraphrase properly instead of copying. Use quotation marks for direct quotes: sleep is essential (Smith, 2020). Always cite your sources.
scenes.say_uz: Smith (2020) sifatli uxlash xotirani yaxshilashini aniqladi. Ko‘chirish o‘rniga to‘g‘ri parafraz qiling. To‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri iqtibos uchun qo‘shtirnoqdan foydalaning: Uxlash muhim (Smith, 2020). Har doim manbalaringizni iqtibos keltiring.

scenes.title: Pametlash mashqi
scenes.say_native: Uchta qoidani ayting: „Smith (2020) found that…“ — manba; „Paraphrase instead of copying“ — ko‘chirmang; „Sleep is essential (Smith, 2020)“ — qo‘shtirnoq. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida ayting. Topshiriqni vaqt ichida yozing — 20 daqiqa ichida 150 so‘z yozing — kerak bo‘lganda qisqartiring.
scenes.say: Smith (2020) found that adequate sleep improves recall. Paraphrase instead of copying. Use quotation marks: sleep is essential (Smith, 2020). Cite every source.
scenes.say_uz: Smith (2020) sifatli uxlash xotirani yaxshilashini aniqladi. Ko‘chirish o‘rniga parafraz qiling. Qo‘shtirnoqdan foydalaning: Uxlash muhim (Smith, 2020). Har bir manbani iqtibos keltiring.

scenes.title: ESCUCHA 1: akademik suhbat
board: A: What is the aim of the study?
B: To investigate sleep and learning.
A: What did the results indicate?
B: That adequate sleep improves recall.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi suhbatni tinglang — akademik suhbat. A: „What is the aim of the study?“ — tadqiqotning maqsadi nima? B: „To investigate sleep and learning“ — uxlash va o‘rganishni aniqlash. A: „What did the results indicate?“ — natijalar nimani ko‘rsatdi? B: „That adequate sleep improves recall“ — sifatli uxlash xotirani yaxshilashini. Diqqat qiling: aim — result — abstractning ikki asosiy savoli. Savollar: tadqiqotning maqsadi va natijasi nima? Namuna abstractni ko‘p marta o‘qing — beshta qismini toping — va o‘zingizga aylantiring.
scenes.say: What is the aim of the study? To investigate sleep and learning. What did the results indicate? That adequate sleep improves recall.
scenes.say_uz: Tadqiqotning maqsadi nima? Uxlash va o‘rganishni aniqlash. Natijalar nimani ko‘rsatdi? Sifatli uxlash xotirani yaxshilashini.

scenes.title: Suhbat 1 bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: Suhbat bo‘yicha to‘rtta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: tadqiqotning maqsadi nima — uxlash va o‘rganishni aniqlash. Ikkinchi: natijalar nimani ko‘rsatdi — sifatli uxlash xotirani yaxshilashini. Uchinchi: bu abstractning qaysi qismlari — aim va result. To‘rtinchi: ohang — akademik. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida ayting. Bugun o‘rganganingizni har kuni mashq qiling — akademik yozuv — mashq orqali o‘zlashtiriladi.
scenes.say: What is the aim of the study? What did the results indicate? Which sections of an abstract are these? What is the tone? Answer in English.
scenes.say_uz: Tadqiqotning maqsadi nima? Natijalar nimani ko‘rsatdi? Bu abstractning qaysi qismlari? Ohang qanday? Ingliz tilida javob bering.

scenes.title: Javoblar: suhbat 1
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Maqsad — „To investigate sleep and learning“ — uxlash va o‘rganish. Natija — „That adequate sleep improves recall“ — uxlash xotirani yaxshilaydi. Abstractning aim va result qismlari. Akademik abstract — har doim — aim — result — conclusion — uchtala birga. Muntazam mashq qiling. Keyingi dars huquqiy va rasmiy hujjatlar tili — huquq — yana bir professional yo‘nalish. Javoblaringizni matnga qaray turib ayting — ular aniqroq va professionalroq bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: The aim is to investigate sleep and learning. The results indicate that adequate sleep improves recall. These are the aim and result sections of an abstract. Every academic abstract has these parts.
scenes.say_uz: Maqsad — uxlash va o‘rganishni aniqlash. Natijalar — sifatli uxlash xotirani yaxshilashini ko‘rsatadi. Bu abstractning aim va result qismlari. Har bir akademik abstractda bu qismlar mavjud.

scenes.title: ESCUCHA 2: abstract muhokamasi
board: A: Background, aim, method, result, conclusion.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi suhbatni tinglang — abstract muhokamasi. A: „Write a 150-word abstract“ — 150 so‘zli abstract yozing. B: „What should I include?“ — nimani kiritishim kerak? A: „Background, aim, method, result, conclusion“ — background, aim, method, result, conclusion. B: „How long?“ — qancha uzun? A: „150-250 words“ — 150-250 so‘z. Diqqat qiling: abstractning beshta qismi va so‘z soni — har doim belgilangan. undefined
scenes.say: Write a 150-word abstract. What should I include? Background, aim, method, result, conclusion. How long? 150-250 words.
scenes.say_uz: 150 so‘zli abstract yozing. Nimani kiritishim kerak? Background, aim, method, result, conclusion. Qancha uzun? 150-250 so‘z.

scenes.title: Suhbat 2 bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: Suhbat bo‘yicha to‘rtta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: abstract nima — qisqa xulosa. Ikkinchi: beshta qism nima — background, aim, method, result, conclusion. Uchinchi: so‘z soni qancha — 150-250. To‘rtinchi: ohang — akademik va professional. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida ayting. undefined Javoblaringizni takrorlang — akademik suhbatda kuch — aniqlikdan keladi.
scenes.say: What is an abstract? What are its five parts? How many words? What is the tone? Answer in English.
scenes.say_uz: Abstract nima? Uning beshta qismi nima? Qancha so‘z? Ohang qanday? Ingliz tilida javob bering.

scenes.title: Javoblar: suhbat 2
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Abstract — qisqa xulosa — „Write a 150-word abstract“ — beshta qism — background, aim, method, result, conclusion. So‘z soni — 150-250. Ingliz tilida akademik abstract — har doim — qisqa — aniq — beshta qism. Muntazam mashq qiling. undefined
scenes.say: An abstract is a short summary. Its five parts are background, aim, method, result and conclusion. The length is 150-250 words. Every academic publication requires one.
scenes.say_uz: Abstract — qisqa xulosa. Uning beshta qismi: background, aim, method, result va conclusion. Hajmi 150-250 so‘z. Har bir akademik nashr uni talab qiladi.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: 150 so‘zli abstract yozing
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Ingliz tilida 150 so‘zli abstract yozing: 1) background; 2) aim; 3) method; 4) result; 5) conclusion. Iqtibos iboralarini ishlating — according to — suggests. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida ayting. undefined
scenes.say: Write a 150-word abstract in English: background, aim, method, result and conclusion. Use citation phrases and hedged language.
scenes.say_uz: Ingliz tilida 150 so‘zli abstract yozing: background, aim, method, result va conclusion. Iqtibos iboralari va akademik muloyimlikdan foydalaning.

scenes.title: Namuna abstract
scenes.say_native: Namuna abstract. „Background: adequate sleep is essential for memory consolidation. Aim: this study investigates the effect of sleep on recall. Method: a survey of 200 university students was conducted. Result: the results suggest that adequate sleep significantly improves recall. Conclusion: adequate sleep should be integrated into study routines.“ Sizning abstractingiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin — muhimi beshta qism. Ingliz tilida abstract — har doim qisqa va aniq. undefined Namuna abstractni yodlab oling — keyin uni o‘zingizga moslang — men sizga yuz foiz ishonaman.
scenes.say: Background: adequate sleep is essential for memory consolidation. Aim: this study investigates the effect of sleep on recall. Method: a survey of 200 students was conducted. Result: the results suggest adequate sleep improves recall. Conclusion: adequate sleep should be integrated into study routines.
scenes.say_uz: Background: sifatli uxlash xotira konsolidatsiyasi uchun zarur. Aim: ushbu tadqiqot uxlashning xotiraga ta’sirini o‘rganadi. Method: 200 universitet talabasini so‘rov qildik. Result: natijalar sifatli uxlash xotirani sezilarli yaxshilashini ko‘rsatadi. Conclusion: sifatli uxlash o‘qish odatlariga kiritilishi kerak.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
scenes.say_native: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik? Ingliz tilida akademik yozuvni: abstract tuzilishini — background, aim, method, result, conclusion; parafraz va xulosani; iqtibos iboralarini — according to — argues — suggests; akademik hedgingni — suggests — appears to — may; pametlashdan qochishni. Endi har qanday akademik matnni yoza olasiz. undefined
scenes.say: Today we learned academic writing: abstract structure, paraphrasing, citing, hedging and avoiding plagiarism. Keep practicing.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun akademik yozuvni o‘rgandik: abstract tuzilishi, parafraz, iqtibos, hedging va pametlashdan qochish. Mashq qilishni davom ettiring.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa. Ingliz tilida 150 so‘zli abstract yozing — beshta qism va iqtibos iboralari bilan. Keyingi darsda huquqiy va rasmiy hujjatlar tilini o‘rganamiz. Goodbye! undefined
scenes.say: Write a 150-word abstract in English. Next lesson: legal and formal documents. Goodbye!
scenes.say_uz: Ingliz tilida 150 so‘zli abstract yozing. Keyingi darsda huquqiy va rasmiy hujjatlar tilini o‘rganamiz. Xayr!

homework_uz: Ingliz tilida 150 so‘zli abstract yozing — background, aim, method, result va conclusion bilan. Keyingi dars: Huquqiy va rasmiy hujjatlar tili.

quiz.q: „The findings appear to support…“ nimani bildiradi?
